shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && cat specs/lore-test-descriptors/spec.md && cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n 'lore-list-tests|spec anchor|specs/lore-test-descriptors'"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat scripts/lore-list-tests.test.ts && cat package.json && cat jest.config.js && rg -n 'specs/.*/spec.md#[0-9]+' scripts | head -30 && ls scripts/spec-links"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"['jest', '--json', "'`--outputFile=${reportFile}`]", "['"'jest', '--json', '--testLocationInResults', "'`--outputFile=${reportFile}`]")
s=s.replace("  return suite.assertionResults.map(assertion => ({'"\\n    id:\", \"  const lines = source.split(/\\\\r?\\\\n/);\\n\\n  return suite.assertionResults.map(assertion => {\\n    const preceding = lines[(assertion.location?.line ?? 0) - 2];\\n    const testSpec = preceding?.match(/"'^'"\\\\s*\\\\/\\\\/\\\\s*(specs\\\\/[\\\\w/-]+\\\\/spec\\\\.md#\\\\d+)\\\\s*"'$/)?.[1] ?? spec;'"\\n    return {\\n    id:\")
s=s.replace(\"    ...(spec ? {spec} : {}),\\n  }));\", \"    ...(testSpec ? {spec: testSpec} : {}),\\n    };\\n  });\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='specs/lore-test-descriptors/spec.md';s=open(p).read().replace('| Status | Implemented |\\n', '| Status | Implemented |\\n\\nLore test descriptors connect listed tests to the specification statements they validate.\\n');s += '\\n- When a file contains multiple spec anchor stamps, each test descriptor uses the stamp immediately preceding its declaration ([validated by: associates each test with its own preceding stamp](../../scripts/lore-multiple-anchors.test.ts#L7)).\\n';open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.lore/dod.md';s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Associate individual tests with their own anchors when a test file contains multiple spec stamps.', '- [x] Associate individual tests with their own anchors when a test file contains multiple spec stamps.');open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath scripts/lore-multiple-anchors.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts/lore-multiple-anchors.test.ts specs/lore-test-descriptors/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git diff --stat && git diff -- scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/lore-test-descriptors/spec.md && git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts/lore-multiple-anchors.test.ts specs/lore-test-descriptors/spec.md && git commit -m 'Associate test descriptors with individual spec anchors' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
